objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Use the Command Execution category to run a command on the web server and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The first Command Execution level hands a query string value straight to the shell.
The later levels filter some characters: think about which shell metacharacters the filter forgets, as a class of bypass.

steps.title: Pick the category
steps.prompt: Which category of the site runs operating system commands with your input?

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which query string parameter does level 1 pass to the shell?

steps.title: Find the sink
steps.prompt: Which PHP function runs the command and returns its output?
